lines.text: Added an option to switch Silent Reload Mode between Hold and Toggle. With toggle enabled, once the silent reload starts you can let go of the reload button. To cancel a silent reload and go back to a fast reload, you can tap the reload button again.
Fixed various cases where the first sound of a reload was audible irrespective if a user requested a silent reload or not.
Fixed a bug where liquid could render as black on AMD video cards
Fixed some sound and UI bugs when rewinding during demo playback
